remarks:
Hunting and recreational land (Lot 5) with outstanding access and diverse terrain in Granger, NY, Allegany County.

This 5.4-acre lot offers the habitat, terrain, and access that make it an ideal recreational property. This corner tract features approximately 735 feet of frontage on Flat Iron Road and 976 feet on Gelser Road, providing convenient access from two roads and flexibility for future use. A diverse mix of mature hardwoods, softwoods, and pines covers the property, while the gently rolling topography, hardwood ridges, and a rock-bottom seasonal creek create ideal habitat and natural travel corridors for deer, turkey, and other wildlife. Several interior openings make the property ready to enjoy from day one. Internet is available along Gelser Road. Electric service is available in the area.

Owner financing is available with 10% down and terms of up to 10 years at 10% APR. All rights convey.

Located just minutes from English Hill State Forest, you'll have easy access to thousands of additional acres for hunting, hiking, snowmobiling, and year-round outdoor recreation.
